April 19, 34.

Dear Mr. Sarly,

I forward herewith for your information tabulated
statements relating to the arrest by the Municipal Police
of eight communists named (1) Liu Vung Shang ( 刘文祥 )
alias Liu Yoong Foh ( 刘永福 ), (2) Zung Yih Ming ( 张一民 )
alias Lau Zung ( 老张 ) alias Zung Nyi Si ( 张二兄 ), (3)
Zung Yeu ( 张瑜 ) and (4) Zung Li Sz ( 张李氏 ) (female)
arrested at 4.20 p.m. on April 6, 1934 at 41 Meu Yih Li
( 模益里 ), Myburgh Road, (5) Lieu Zau Sz ( 刘赵氏 ) (female)
arrested at 5.15 p.m. on April 6, 1934 at 84 Tien Foh Li
( 天福里 ), Tse Pang Road, (6) Lieu Kah Ming ( 刘克明 ) alias
Lau Koeh ( 老葛 ) arrested at 9.45 p.m. on April 6, 1934 at
82 Bei Tuh Li ( 培德里 ), Tatung Road, (7) Fung Sz Foo ( 冯士富 )
arrested at 9.50 p.m. on April 6, 1934 at No.49, Lane 435,
Range Road and (8) Sung Pao Gee ( 宋宝琪 ) alias Lau Li ( 老李 )
alias Li Ah Tsong ( 李阿宗 ) at 11 a.m. on April 7, 1934
outside 41 Meu Yih Li, Myburgh Road.

The eight accused appeared on remand before the Second
Branch of the Kiangsu High Court on April 14, 1934 when the
1st, 2nd, 3rd, 6th and 8th accused were ordered to be
extradited to the Chinese authorities while the remaining
three (4th, 5th and 7th accused) were acquitted.

Documents seized at No 41 Meu Yih Li,

Exhibits No 1 to 3.

Consist of the accounts of the Federation of Labour Unions
for the months of February and March 1934 and the estimates
of the same body for the month of April. They show that
the majority of the activities of the Federation are con-
-ducted among utility, cotton trade and wharf workers; which

documents to the Municipal Workers is rather misleading and
does not refer only to S.M.C. employees. I suggest that
the reference should be translated as meaning 'Utility
Workers' and should be accepted as dealing with the employees
of the Shanghai Power Company in particular.

Exhibit No 4.

Deals mainly with the work performed by the Federation during
the month of February 1934 and gives a tabulated list of the
numbers of members in local labour circles and their location.
There is no doubt that these figures are to some extent
over estimated, they do, however, give an idea of the actual
active strength of the Party. The figures adduced from the
documents are as follows:-

关于特别分支主管于1934年4月14日发出的备忘录，现随函附上1934年4月6日在执行上述逮捕令过程中于各地址查获的中文文件的译本副本。

在迈尔赫路模益里41号查获的文件包括以下内容：-

证物第1至3号。

由工会联合会1934年2月和3月的账目以及该团体4月份的预算组成。这些文件显示，该联合会的大部分活动是在公用事业、棉纺织业和码头工人中开展的；这三类企业构成了本地大多数半熟练劳动力。这些文件中提及的“市政工人”具有相当的误导性，并非仅指工部局雇员。我建议将其翻译为“公用事业工人”，并理解为特指上海电力公司的员工。

证物第4号。

主要涉及联合会在1934年2月期间开展的工作，并列出了当地劳工界成员人数及其分布情况的统计表。毫无疑问，这些数据在一定程度上被高估了，但它们确实提供了对党派实际活跃力量的概念。从文件中引用的数据如下：-

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of **Lieu Yung Shang ( 刘 永 祥 )**.
native of **Peiping** taken by me **D.S. Jones (Special Branch)**.
at **Sinsa Station** on the **6/4/34** and interpreted by **Clerk Chang**.

My name is Lieu Yung Shang, age 33, my home address is No.2
Zung Yaung Road ( 成 义 街 ), West Gate, Peiping. The house
is the property of my father and he resides there with my mo-
ther.

At the age of 12, I entered the 20th Primary School, Peiping.
I remained there as a student until I had reached the age of
18 years. I then left school and became an accountant at the
Kyung Hwa ( 京 華 ) Printing Company, Sing Hwa Street ( 新 華 街 ).
I remained in this employ until I was 32 years of age, being
discharged on the 17th or 18th of December last year on account
of business depression. After this I was unemployed and lived
with my parents who own house property in Peiping. On March
24, 1934 I received a letter from my friend Zung Yih Ming
( 张 一 民 ), living at No.41 Shanhaikwan Road, Shanghai, ad-
vising me to come to this city to find a position: I according-
ly left Peiping three days ago by train and on arrival here
last evening, went to live with Zung at No.41 Shanhaikwan Road.

I do not know anything about the communistic literature
found in the room which I was sharing with Zung Yih Ming and
the latter 's wife. I did not know it was of a communistic
nature as I had not looked at it. The other man arrested in
the room with Zung Yih Ming, his wife, and myself is unknown to
me and I had never seen him before. He entered the room at
the same time as the Police. I saw them take a bundle of
papers from his pocket, but did not see what the papers were.

I do not know whether my friend Zung Yih Ming has any poli-
tical connections or not. I myself am not a communist, neither
do I belong to any political party.

以下是**刘永祥（Lieu Yung Shang）**的陈述，他是**北平**人，由我**D.S. Jones（特科）**于**1934年4月6日**在**新闸捕房**录取，并由**张书记员**翻译。

我叫刘永祥，33岁，家住北平西化成义街2号。该房屋是我父亲的财产，他与我的母亲居住在那里。

12岁时，我进入北平第二十小学读书。我一直作为学生留在那里，直到18岁。随后我离开学校，成为新华街京华印刷公司的会计。我一直受雇于此，直到32岁，去年12月17日或18日因生意萧条而被解雇。此后我一直失业，与在北平拥有房产的父母同住。1934年3月24日，我收到住在上海山海关路41号的朋友张一民（Zung Yih Ming）的来信，建议我来这座城市找工作：于是我于三天前乘火车离开北平，昨晚抵达此处后，便去山海关路41号与张一民同住。

我对在与张一民及其妻子合住的房间里发现的共产主义文献一无所知。我不知道那是共产主义性质的，因为我未曾看过。与张一民、其妻子和我一起在房间里被捕的另一名男子我不认识，以前也从未见过他。他与警察同时进入房间。我看到他们从他口袋里拿出一捆文件，但没看清文件是什么。

我不知道我的朋友张一民是否有政治联系。我自己不是共产党员，也不属于任何政党。

pages.en:
Zung Yih Ming (陈一民)
Chinkongpoo, Kiangsu. D.P.S. Lingard.
6p.m.. 6-4-34. Clerk Tsao.

My name is Zung Yih Ming (陈一民) alias Zung Nyi Si (陈义之).
I am married and have 2 children. My wife's name is Zung
Lee Sz. I am 32 years of age. I was born in Chinkongpoo,
Kiangsu. I remained at home till I was 10 years to when I
started to study at a small school in Chinkongpoo, where I
remained till I was 17 years old. I then went to the Provincial
Normal School at Chinkiang where I continued my studies to
the age of twenty. I could by this time speak and write
a little English and in consequence I obtained employment
in the Shanghai General Post Office, as a clerk. In the
summer of 1922, on leaving school I came straight to Shanghai.
On reaching Shanghai North Station, I went straight to No.
40 Sai Wei Li (三畏里), off Manchu Road, Chapei, the home
of my cousin Tsag Ying Kyung (张英卿). I spent 3 months with
this cousin, during which I visited various friends to try and
get work. The friends I visited were:-
1. Sing Zung Foo (秦仁甫), off Avenue Edward VII near a
Cotton Exchange.
2. Li Augh Kyung (李亚卿), residence now demolished,
formerly corner of Honan & Tientsin Roads.
3. Zung Eh Ming (陈乙民), residing at No. 10 Nee Ping Li
(新平里) off Paoshan Road (宝山路), Chapei. This house
was also destroyed during the recent hostilities.
I was guaranteed in the General Post Office by a friend,
called Tsah (蔡), whose other names I forget.
Tsah was the proprietor of the Hung Foong Sack Shop
(恒丰袋庄), No. 7 New North Gate.
pages.zh:
张一民（陈一民）
江苏青浦。D.P.S. Lingard。
下午6点。1934年4月6日。曹书记员。

我叫张一民（陈一民），别名张义之（陈义之）。我已婚，有两个孩子。我妻子的名字是张李氏（Zung Lee Sz）。我今年32岁。出生于江苏青浦。我在家待到10岁，开始在青浦的一所小学校读书，一直读到17岁。随后我去镇江省立师范学校继续学业，直到20岁。此时我能说写一点英语，因此我在上海邮政总局找到了一份职员的工作。1922年夏天，毕业后我直接来到上海。到达上海北站后，我直接去了闸北满洲路三畏里40号，这是我表哥张英卿（Tsag Ying Kyung）的家。我在这位表亲家住了3个月，期间拜访了各种朋友试图找工作。我拜访的朋友有：-
1. 秦仁甫（Sing Zung Foo），住在爱德华七世路棉花交易所附近。
2. 李亚卿（Li Augh Kyung），住所现已拆除，原址在河南路与天津路转角。
3. 陈乙民（Zung Eh Ming），住在闸北宝山路新平里10号。该房屋也在最近的战事中被毁。
我在邮政总局由一位姓蔡（Tsah）的朋友担保，他的其他名字我忘记了。
蔡是新北门恒丰袋庄7号的老板。

pages.en:
2.
Zung Yih Ming continued.

When I was employed in the General Post Office I occupied
an unnumbered house on Wonglo Road (黃陸路), near Kiangwan
Road. My address was registered in the General Post Office
as No. 60 Sai Wei Li off Manchu Road. 60 Sai Wei Li was
occupied by a friend of mine Szue Wah Yue (徐華裕), formerly
employed in a Japanese firm as a clerk.

I remained at Wonglo Road for about a year, and then moved
to 21 Tsoong Fu Li (昌傅里), off Yang Ka Pang Road (楊家浜路),
Chapei, where I remained for about 4 years. I next moved to
No. 780 Point Road (old number), which place I lived in for
about five years. I applied for leave and went to Peking
on July 1st 1930 for 3 weeks and Tientsin for 1 week. During
my leave at these places, I visited various school friends,
among whom was Lieu Vung Shang (劉文祥), who was a clerk in
the Peking Financial Bureau. This man was arrested with me
today.

I returned from Tientsin to Shanghai. I returned to Point
Road, where I spent the rest of my leave studying law. I
resumed on February 1st. 1931 and in November 1931 I was
transferred to Sungkiang Post Office. At Sungkiang I lived
at the Post Office quarters. I was transferred back to
Shanghai in June 1932. On returning to Shanghai I went to
live at No. 24 Tsung Yang Li (崇陽里), off E. Yuhang Road,
where I lived till December 1933. In March 1933, I resigned
from the General Post Office and since then I have been earn-
ing a living by writing books etc at my house.

On December 1933, I moved to 359 Tsang An Li (長安里) off
pages.zh:
2.
张一民续述。

当我在邮政总局工作时，我住在黄陆路靠近江湾路的一栋无门牌号的房子里。我在邮政总局登记的地址是满洲路三畏里60号。三畏里60号住着我的朋友徐华裕（Szue Wah Yue），他以前在日本公司当职员。

我在黄陆路住了大约一年，然后搬到了闸北杨家浜路昌傅里21号，在那里住了大约4年。接着我搬到了宾路（Point Road）780号（旧门牌号），在那里住了大约五年。我请假并于1930年7月1日去北京呆了3周，去天津呆了1周。在这些地方休假期间，我拜访了各种同学，其中包括刘文祥（Lieu Vung Shang），他是北平财政局的职员。这个人今天和我一起被捕。

我从天津回到上海。我回到宾路，在剩余的假期里学习法律。我于1931年2月1日复职，1931年11月被调往松江邮局。在松江，我住在邮局宿舍。1932年6月我被调回上海。回到上海后，我住在东余杭路崇阳里24号，一直住到1933年12月。1933年3月，我从邮政总局辞职，此后一直靠在家写书等谋生。

1933年12月，我搬到了长安里359号，位于

pages.en:
3.
Zung Yih Ming continued.

Singkeipang Road, where I remained till March 6th 1934, when
I moved to No. 41 Meu Yih Li (梅益里), off Shan haikwan Road.
I do not know how any Communist literature managed to get
into my bedroom at 41 Meu Yih Li, where It was found by the
S.M.P. today, as I am not a Communist and have never had any
dealing with the Communist Party.
    I do not know Zung Yue (陈瑜) or do I understand why he
was at my house today.
    The above statement is true.

                    Signed by Zung Yih Ming.
pages.zh:
3.
张一民续述。

新吉邦路（Singkeipang Road），一直住到1934年3月6日，随后搬到了山海关路梅益里41号。我不知道任何共产主义文献是如何进入我在梅益里41号的卧室的，今天工部局警务处在那里发现了这些文献，因为我不是共产党员，也从未与共产党有过任何往来。
    我不认识陈瑜（Zung Yue），也不明白他今天为什么在我家。
    以上陈述属实。

                    张一民签名。

Zung Yue (曾悦)
Hupeh                                D.P.S. Lingard.
7.30p.m.        6-4-54.

                                     Clerk Zung.

    My name is Zung Yue. I am 28 years of age and am single.
I am a native of Hupeh. I was born in Peiping. My father
was a small farmer. I started studying when I was 8 years
old at a small school in Peiping, called The Peking Kuoming
School (北平國民學校), where I remained till I was 15 years old.
Next I went to a large school in Peking, called The Wu-Zung
School (五中學校), where I remained for 4 years. I left the
Wu-Zung School and went to study at, The "Chung-Kwok-Da-Hsioh"
(中國大學), where I remained, five years.
    On leaving this university, I remained in Peiping at
various lodging houses until January 1934, when I set out
for Shanghai. I do not remember the names of these lodging
houses. While I was living in these various lodging houses,
I was kept by my father who kept sending me money. When I
reached Shanghai on Jan. 2nd. I went to 553 Mingkuo Road,
Rue de les Republiques, where I have been living ever since.
I am unemployed and I came to Shanghai to look for work. This
morning I got up at 8a.m. and read papers and books, I had
my tiffin at noon, after tiffin, I left my house and walked:
to Tatung Road/Shanhaikwan Road corner. As I was walking down
an alleyway, Hue Yih Li (惠益里), I was just at the door of
No. 41, when I was arrested.
    I admit being a Communist but I refuse to reveal any
particulars of the work, I did for the Communist Party, to the
S.M.P., but I shall make a full statement to the Chinese
Authorities, if I am handed over to them. The Communist
literature found on my person was my property. I do not know
any of the other accused.

                        Signed by:- Zung Yue.

曾悦 (Zung Yue)
湖北                                警务处副督察长 Lingard。
晚上7:30        1934年4月6日。

                                     书记员 Zung。

    我叫曾悦。我今年28岁，未婚。
我是湖北人。我出生在北平。我的父亲
是一名小农。我8岁时开始在北平一所名为北平国民学校的小学校读书，在那里一直读到15岁。
随后我进入北京一所名为五中学校的大学校，在那里读了4年。我离开五中学校后，进入“中国大学”学习，在那里读了五年。
    离开这所大学后，我在北平的各种寄宿寓所居住，直到1934年1月启程前往上海。我不记得这些寄宿寓所的名字。在我居住在这些不同寄宿寓所期间，我的生活费用由父亲负担，他不断给我寄钱。当我于1月2日抵达上海时，我去了民国路（Rue de les Republiques）553号，自那时起我一直住在那里。我失业，来上海是为了找工作。今天早上我8点起床，阅读报纸和书籍，中午吃了便饭，饭后我离开家，步行至大同路与山海关路的拐角处。当我走过惠益里的一条弄堂时，我刚走到41号门口，就被逮捕了。
    我承认自己是共产党员，但我拒绝向工部局警务处透露我为共产党工作的任何具体细节，但如果我被移交给中国当局，我将向他们作出完整陈述。在我身上搜出的共产主义文献是我的财产。我不认识其他任何被告。

                        签名：- 曾悦。

Zung Li Sz (陳李氏).
Hwai Ying Hsien                                D.S. Jones (Special Branch ).
Sinsa Station        6/4/34.                   Clerk Chang.

My name is Zung Li Sz (陳李氏), age 32. I was born in Hwai
Ying Hsien (淮陰縣), Kiangsu. At Hwai Ying my parents had abou'
ten mow of land. My father died ten years ago while my mother
gains her livelihood from the farm. I never went to school and
am not able to read or write. Until I was 20 years of age I
worked on the farm. I then married Zung Yih Ming (陳一民), a
native of the same village as myself whom I had known since
childhood. For six years after marriage my husband and I re-
mained at Hwai Ying. During this period he was editor of a
newspaper there. I don't know the name of it. After this we
came to Shanghai, where we have been for the past five or six
years.

I do not know whether the house which we lived in for about
five years was in the International Settlement, the French Con-
cession or Chinese Territory. I am only a country woman and do
not know Shanghai; I could not find my way back to the house.
We have been living at our present address in Shanghaikwan
Road for the past month.

Since we have been in Shanghai my husband has been working
at a newspaper office: I do not know which one as he never told
me. He did not tell me about his business.

The man Lieu (劉) (Lieu Tung Sheng 劉文祥) I first saw
about two weeks ago, when he came to ask my husband for a job.
He does not live with us and I do not know his address. Although
Lieu visited us three or four times, I understood that my hus-
band knew Lieu before at Hwai Ying. Each time Lieu visited us
would ask my husband about a job. I did not hear either him or
pages.zh:
陈李氏 (Zung Li Sz)。
淮阴县                                特别处警探 Jones。
新闸捕房        1934年4月6日。                   书记员 Chang。

我叫陈李氏，32岁。我出生于江苏淮阴县。在淮阴，我的父母拥有大约十亩土地。我的父亲十年前去世，而我的母亲依靠农田维持生计。我从未上过学，不会读写。直到20岁，我一直在务农。随后我嫁给了陈一民 (Zung Yih Ming)，他是与我同村的人，我从小就认识他。婚后六年，我和丈夫一直住在淮阴。在此期间，他是当地一家报纸的编辑。我不知道报纸的名字。之后我们来到上海，在这里已经住了五六年。

我不知道我们住了大约五年的那所房子是在公共租界、法租界还是华界。我只是个乡下女人，不熟悉上海；我找不到回那所房子的路。过去一个月，我们一直住在山海关路目前的地址。

自从我们来到上海后，我丈夫一直在一家报社工作：我不知道是哪一家，因为他从未告诉过我。他没有告诉我他的业务情况。

刘姓男子（刘）（刘文祥 Lieu Tung Sheng），我大约在两周前第一次见到他，当时他来向我丈夫求职。他不和我们住在一起，我也不知道他的地址。虽然刘来访过三四次，但我知道我丈夫以前在淮阴就认识刘。每次刘来访都会向我丈夫询问工作的事。我没有听到他或

Lieu Zau Sz (劉祖氏)
Peiping.                                D.P.S. Lingard.
8p.m.           6-4-34.                 Clerk Zung.

    My name is Lieu Zau Sz (劉祖氏). I am 26 years old. I
am the wife of the man Lieu Tuh Hai (劉突海), who was
arrested at 41 Meu Yih Li. I married him over 4 years ago.
My husband was a reporter in a newspaper, in Peking when he
used to work in an office in San Mo Lu (      ). I have been
from Peking
in Shanghai about forty days. My husband came to Shanghai
about two months ago. The reason for my husband coming
to Shanghai was to look for work, as the paper for which he
was working in Peking ceased to be published. When my
husband reached Shanghai he went to Tsze-Pang -Road, Tien
Foh Li, house No. 48 where he has been living since. I have
lived with my husband since my arrival in Shanghai. My
husband is now reporting for the Sin Wan Pao. His salary
is about $40.00 a month. I am not aware of there being
anything of a Communist nature in any of my husband's under-
takings. I am sure he is not a Communist, any more than I
am. This statement is true.

                Finger-printed by Lieu Zau Sz.

刘祖氏 (Lieu Zau Sz)
北平。                                警务处副督察长 Lingard。
晚上8点           1934年4月6日。                 书记员 Zung。

    我叫刘祖氏。我26岁。我是刘突海 (Lieu Tuh Hai) 的妻子，他在缪益里41号被捕。我四年前嫁给他。我丈夫在北京的一家报社当记者，当时他在三马路 (      ) 的一间办公室工作。我来上海大约四十天了。我丈夫大约两个月前来到上海。我丈夫来上海的原因是为了找工作，因为他在北京工作的报纸停刊了。当我丈夫到达上海时，他去了芝罘路天福里48号，并一直住在那里。自从我到达上海后，我就和丈夫住在一起。我丈夫现在为《新闻报》做报道工作。他的薪水大约是每月40美元。我不知道我丈夫的任何活动中有共产主义性质的内容。我确信他不是共产党员，我也不是。此陈述属实。

                按指印：刘祖氏。

pages.en:
Lieu Kuh Ming (刘克明)
Honan D.P.S. Lingard.
11p.m. 6-4-54. Clerk Tsao.

My name is Lieu Kuh Ming (刘克明). I am a native of Honan.
I am 24 years old. I am not married. I was born in Nan-
Whaung Hsien, Honan. My father Lieu Yen Chieh (刘彦杰),
was a farmer. I started studying when I was 8 years old,
when my father taught me until I was about 12 years of age.
I then went to the Nan-Whaung Hsien Primary School, and
remained studying at this place for 3 years. I left this
school to go to the "Ming Dok" Middle School (民德中学) at
Peking, where I studied till I was 18 years old. I left this
school about June 1928 and got a post as proof reader in the
Ching Hwa Printing Company, Peking. I lived at this time,
at No. 15 Yientz-da-ka (一尺大街), Peking. I spent 6 years
in this place working as a proof-reader till the printing
works reduced their staff owing to lack of trade in March
1934. I then came straight to Shanghai, by the B. & S.
steamer S.S. Zungching. I reached Shanghai, on the afternoon
of April 6th. at 4.50p.m. I landed at the B. &. S. Wharf,
on the Bund. I went straight to 124 Canton Road to locate
a friend called Wong Su Ren (王树仁), but I found that he has
recently removed to some place, unknown to me. I next went
to a bath house at Canton Road, where I spent about four hours
when I walked to No. 82 Bei Tuh Li, off Sinza Road, where I
was arrested. I went to this place by accident as I was
looking for a friend Waung Su Zang (王树长), who lives near there.
I am not a Communist and have no communist friends. The
keys which were found in my pocket which happened to fit the
room over the kitchen are not mine. The fact that the No. 1
tenant recognises me is a mystery to me. This is true.

Signed by: Lieu Kuh Ming.

河南 警务处副督察长 Lingard。
晚上11点 1934年4月6日。 书记员 Tsao。

我叫刘克明。我是河南人。
我24岁。未婚。我出生在河南南华县。我的父亲刘彦杰 (Lieu Yen Chieh)，是一名农民。我8岁时开始读书，由父亲教我直到大约12岁。随后我进入南华县小学，在那里学习了3年。我离开这所学校去北京的“民德中学”读书，一直读到18岁。我大约在1928年6月离开这所学校，并在北京清华印刷公司获得了一份校对员的职位。当时我住在北京一尺大街15号。我在那里做了6年的校对员，直到1934年3月，由于生意清淡，印刷厂裁员。随后我直接乘坐英商轮船公司的“中兴”轮 (S.S. Zungching) 来到上海。我于4月6日下午4点50分抵达上海。我在外滩的英商轮船公司码头登岸。我直接去广东路124号寻找一位名叫王树仁 (Wong Su Ren) 的朋友，但我发现他最近搬走了，去向不明。接着我去了广东路的一家浴室，在那里待了大约四个小时，然后走到新闸路附近的北杜里82号，在那里我被逮捕了。我去那个地方是偶然的，因为我正在寻找住在那附近的一位朋友王树长 (Waung Su Zang)。我不是共产党员，也没有共产党员朋友。在我口袋里发现的恰好能打开厨房楼上房间钥匙不是我的。一号房客认出我这件事对我来说是个谜。此陈述属实。

签名：刘克明。

Sung Poh Jien
Kading                                      x       D.P.S. Lingard
Sinsa Station               April 7                 Clerk Chiang King-yeng

My name is Sung Poh Jien ( 孙宝琪 ). I am a native
of Kading, Kiangsu. I am 31 years of age. I live with my
wife at Kading, outside the East Gate, in an unnumbered house
in the Sung Ka Zah. My father was a farmer in Kading. I
started studying at the age of 10 years when I had a private
tutor. At the age of 20 years, I stopped my studies and helped
my father in my home. At the age of 24 I started work as a
tutor in my own house, when I used to have about 40 pupils.
I continued this teaching for about 6 months, after which I
came to Shanghai and began to teach at the Ming Jen ( 敏求 )
Primary School, at Peng Pei Jan ( 方浜桥 ), West Gate. I
reached Shanghai about January, 1928, when I went to live
in the above named school. I remained about two years in
this school, until I was dismissed on account of my habit of
associating with prostitutes. On being dismissed I went to
live at a small lodging house in Huakes Road and got work first
as a labourer and then porter for about a year. I often slept
on steamers or on the wharf side when I had work there. I was
arrested in October 1930 when I was found by the S.M.P. to be
carrying a bag containing Communistic literature which I was
taking from one Wong Lau San ( 王老三 ), a loafer, to a man
on the Wayside Wharf, whose name I do not know. I was to
recognise this man by the prearranged sign of his having a
handkerchief in his hand. I was in Ward Road Gaol under the
name of Lee Ah Chang ( 李阿昌 ) till August 6th 1932. On
coming out of Gaol I returned to my home in Kading. I
remained at home doing nothing up till to-day at 7 a.m.

我叫孙宝琪。我是江苏嘉定人。今年31岁。我与妻子住在嘉定东门外孙家宅（Sung Ka Zah）的一栋无门牌号的房子里。我父亲是嘉定的农民。我10岁开始读书，由私人教师授课。20岁时，我停止学业，在家帮助父亲。24岁时，我开始在家中担任家庭教师，当时约有40名学生。我继续教书约6个月，随后来到上海，开始在西门方浜桥的敏求小学任教。我于1928年1月左右抵达上海，随即住进上述学校。我在该校待了约两年，后因与妓女交往的习惯而被解雇。被解雇后，我搬到华克路（Huakes Road）的一家小旅馆居住，先做苦力，后做搬运工，历时约一年。在那裡工作时，我经常睡在轮船上或码头边。1930年10月我被捕，当时上海公共租界工部局警务处发现我携带一个装有共产主义文献的包，我正将这些文献从一个名叫王老三的无业游民那里带给外白渡桥码头上的一个男人，此人的姓名我不知道。我要通过预先约定的信号——手中拿着一块手帕——来识别这个人。我在华德路监狱服刑，化名为李阿昌，直至1932年8月6日。出狱后，我回到嘉定的家中。直到今天早上7点离家前，我一直待在家里无所事事。
